title: js-yaml: add a !!regexp type (new type, default schema, exports)
prompt: This is a copy of js-yaml 4.1.0. Add a new built-in YAML type `tag:yaml.org,2002:regexp` (written `!!regexp`). A scalar like `/ab+c/gi` loads as the matching RegExp (flags optional; the pattern may contain escaped slashes such as `/a\/b/`). Malformed values (not slash-delimited, bad flags such as `/abc/zz`, or a non-scalar node) must be load errors. A RegExp value must dump as `!!regexp /source/flags` and round-trip. Register it in the default schema only (CORE_SCHEMA and JSON_SCHEMA stay as they are) and export it as `yaml.types.regexp` like the other types so custom schemas can use it. Put the type in its own file under lib/type/ following the existing ones.
